== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original free deployment from hand replaces a forfeited pilot character after the system battle. The later wording specifies the ship from which that character was forfeited as the destination. The response and free deployment remain, with the same Pilot, pilot bonus and system destiny modifier.
